tagline.text: A five-star integrated resort in Entertainment City, facing Manila Bay

location.label: Location
location.text: 1 Asean Avenue, Entertainment City, Tambo, Parañaque City

children.text: Solaire Resort is the flagship integrated resort of Entertainment City, across from Manila Bay, which opened in March 2013. Two hotel towers (Bay Tower and Sky Tower), 15 or more restaurants and bars, a theater of about 1,740 seats, a casino and a shopping arcade are all in one place.

Solaire Resort Entertainment City stands in Entertainment City (around Aseana City), a reclaimed development zone in Tambo, Parañaque, Metro Manila. It opened on March 16, 2013, and is operated by Bloomberry Resorts and Hotels, while the casino license is held by the Philippine Amusement and Gaming Corporation (PAGCOR). Wikipedia describes the hotel as two 17-storey towers, the Bay Tower and the Sky Tower, with about 800 rooms, suites and villas in total, while the Michelin Guide and resort materials give 793 rooms. Sources differ slightly, so think of it as a resort of roughly 800 rooms.

This is less a "hotel attached to a casino" than a complex where you can spend a whole day. The official website lists 19 restaurants and bars (a 2024 official fact sheet said 15), and the theater, The Theatre at Solaire, seats about 1,740 according to official materials, for musicals and concerts. The shopping arcade, The Shoppes at Solaire, is operated by Ayala Land, and the resort also has a wellness spa, the Solaire Sports Club, an outdoor pool and event spaces. Even families and business travelers who do not gamble can fill a day with dining, shows and the pool.

The Sky Tower is the newer tower, which the official website says has held the Forbes Travel Guide five-star rating for ten consecutive years. Many of its rooms are spacious, from the 65 ㎡ Sky Studio to the 395 ㎡ Chairman's Suite. The Bay Tower is the slightly more classic tower, built around the 43 ㎡ Deluxe Room and the 43 to 52 ㎡ Grand Deluxe, and you can choose a Manila Bay sunset view or a city night view.

The similarly named Solaire Resort North is a separate second resort that opened in May 2024 at Vertis North in Quezon City. This guide covers only the main Entertainment City resort by Manila Bay. When booking, be sure to check whether it is "Solaire Resort Entertainment City" or "North."

blocks.title: Bay Tower and Sky Tower hotels

children.text: The two hotel towers hold
about 800 rooms

and suites. The Bay Tower is built around the 43 ㎡ Deluxe Room and the 43 to 52 ㎡ Grand Deluxe, while the Sky Tower starts with the 65 ㎡ Sky Studio. Some rooms face the Manila Bay sunset and others face the city night view.

Broadway musicals and concerts run in this theater of about 1,740 seats. The official website lists the play "The Play That Goes Wrong" in November 2026, "The Nutcracker" in December and "Chicago" in March 2027, among others. Ticket holders get a pre-show menu and a discount on à la carte menus.

The signature restaurants are the Italian steakhouse Finestra, the Japanese restaurant Yakumi and the Chinese restaurant Red Lantern. With Fresh International Buffet, Lucky Noodles, a food court, Pool Bar & Grill and The Coffee Bean & Tea Leaf, the price range is wide, so you can choose to suit your budget. Some restaurants take bookings through an online reservation service.

This is one of the largest casinos in Manila: the official 2024 fact sheet cites a two-level gaming space of about 30,200 ㎡ with over 2,300 slot machines and more than 400 gaming tables (Wikipedia gives smaller figures, about 18,500 ㎡, 1,620 slots and 360 tables, so sources differ). Many people come just to see the scale and atmosphere even if they do not gamble. There are age and ID checks, so see the cautions below.

There is an outdoor pool with Pool Bar & Grill, a spa, a sauna, a jacuzzi and a beauty salon. The official website's Book Direct benefits include pool access with a day bed for two, which makes the resort a good place to relax during the day.

blocks.title: The Shoppes at Solaire and the boutique

children.text: With the shopping arcade run by Ayala Land and the Solaire Boutique, you can do luxury and souvenir shopping inside the hotel. Ayala Malls Manila Bay and SM Mall of Asia, across from Manila Bay, are also close, so it is easy to add shopping to your itinerary.

The official website lists aerial, art and property tours as experience programs. You can see the artworks and architecture placed throughout the resort with an explanation, so check the operating days and how to sign up at the front desk.

blocks.title: The Space at Solaire and Sky Range

children.text: There is a 1,400 ㎡ event venue, The Space at Solaire, and Sky Range, an interactive shooting experience. Weddings, corporate events and gatherings are also often held here.

Taking a taxi or Grab from central Manila, Makati or BGC is the easiest way. The official FAQ says it takes
20–30 minutes
from Makati and BGC.
Set the destination as "Solaire Resort Entertainment City" (1 Asean Avenue, Parañaque), and take care not to confuse it with the North branch of the same name.
Traffic can be heavy on show days and at rush hour.
Take a taxi or Grab from Ninoy Aquino International Airport (NAIA). The distance is short, but travel time varies a lot with traffic, so leave plenty of time.
For arrival and transfer information in Manila, see also the NAIA guide.
Redemptorist–Aseana station on the LRT-1 Cavite Extension is the nearest railway station, and it began commercial operation on November 16, 2024.
The resort is about
1.5 km
in a straight line from the station, and there is no official guidance on the exact walking or shuttle route, so we recommend combining it with a taxi or Grab.
A free jeepney route connects the station with places such as Ayala Malls Manila Bay. Check locally whether it is running.
The Michelin Guide says both free private parking and paid valet and self-service parking are available. Conditions may change, so check before use.
It is an indoor-focused resort, so you can enjoy it whatever the weather. However, the dry season is best for enjoying the hotel pool and the Manila Bay sunset.
Room rates may rise or rooms may fill early around the year-end holidays, on weekends and on show days, so check prices by date.

You stay inside the resort. The Bay Tower Deluxe Room is the most affordable, and the Sky Tower Sky Studio is larger and newer. The official website's Book Direct offer lists welcome drinks, pool access with a day bed, and 1,000 Solaire Pesos as benefits, and there are also Early Bird (book 30 days ahead) and long stay (7 nights or more) offers. Room rates vary greatly by date, so check the price right before booking.

Dining covers a wide price range. Lucky Noodles or the food court suit a light meal, Fresh buffet suits family gatherings, and Finestra, Yakumi and Red Lantern are known for special occasions. Nearby there are also Michelin-starred restaurants listed by the Michelin Guide, such as Toyo Eatery and FLOW.

Beware of fake booking messages. The official website warns that WhatsApp messages with a link asking you to "confirm" a reservation are not sent by the resort. Do not tap the link, and contact the main number directly.
It pays to check the show schedule and stay packages together. The official website lists stay-and-watch packages.
Be sure to bring your passport or an original government-issued ID. There is guidance that digital copies are not accepted.
Smart casual is the safe choice. The official event FAQ states that slippers, sleeveless jerseys, sports shorts, swimwear and bare feet are not allowed.
Book Direct sometimes comes with welcome drinks and pool day bed benefits, so compare prices with third-party booking sites.
Pool and spa operating hours are not published on the official website, so check as soon as you arrive.
If you only plan to use the hotel and restaurants, it helps to know in advance the route that passes through the casino area.
The North branch of the same brand is in Quezon City, so confirm the branch when you call a taxi.

The casino has an age limit and entry rules are described differently by different sources, so confirm with official information before visiting, and gamble only on your own responsibility and within your budget.
Many sources give the minimum casino entry age as 21, but some say 18, so sources disagree. Check locally.
Set a limit for gambling, and never borrow money to bet even if you run short of cash. The official website has responsible gaming information.
Follow the on-site staff's guidance on whether photography is allowed in the casino area.
When going outside the resort at night, taking a taxi or Grab is safer than walking.
Prices and promotions change often. Check the latest notices.
